purpose: Teach: 門真/三谷/上村/奥山/二宮/坂田/西岡/西山

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、門真署と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: The police are conducting a joint investigation with Kadoma Station, aren't they?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact confirmation. Steady, collaborative tone. No judgment. Speaking as someone on the inside of the process, familiar with procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人三谷氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police will be interviewing witness Mitani, I imagine, to get his statement?
lines.style: Calm, conversational observation. Light lift on the tag question — checking in rather than challenging. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者上村氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And I'm sure the police are being considerate toward the victim Uemura's family as well?
lines.style: Gentle assumption. Warm underneath the procedural language. Acknowledges the human weight of the case without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者奥山氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The police will be organizing the testimony from eyewitness Okuyama, then?
lines.style: Logical next step in the sequence. Even-paced, slightly administrative. Nods along with the process as it unfolds.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者二宮の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: The police will be confirming the suspect Ninomiya's criminal history, I take it?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact procedural point. No surprise in the voice. Straightforward confirmation of standard investigative work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識坂田主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: And you'll be doing a scene verification with Sakata, the forensics supervisor at the station?
lines.style: Acknowledging the on-the-ground work. Practical, knowing. Slightly more direct than the previous questions — moving into hands-on investigation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士西岡様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: Will you also be seeking advice from psychologist Nishi-oka?
lines.style: Thoughtful addition. Recognizes the complexity. Slower on the intake — a moment of genuine consideration before naming the specialist.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の西山様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And I suppose you'll be holding pre-trial conferences with prosecutor Nishiyama as well?
lines.style: Shift to closer, slightly more knowing tone. Acknowledges the legal machinery. Warmer — speaking with someone who knows how these things actually work.
